name: Pearl of Power

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain a spell slot
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower.

summary: Once a day, regain one spent spell slot of level 3 or lower.
text: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a Magic action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
